overview: The paper proposes Latent Visual Reasoning (LVR), a paradigm enabling Multimodal Large Language Models to reason directly in the visual embedding space by reconstructing query-relevant visual tokens via hidden states, interleaved with standard text generation, trained through a two-stage pipeline of joint SFT and GRPOlatent reinforcement learning.

modules.name: Visual CoT Data Preprocessor
modules.description: Parses the Visual CoT dataset to extract image-question pairs and bounding box annotations. Maps the bounding box regions of interest (ROIs) to their corresponding visual patch indices in the ViT encoder grid for SFT supervision.

modules.name: RL Data Preprocessor
modules.description: Processes the ViRL dataset for the reinforcement learning stage. Formats image-text pairs into conversation structures without requiring ROI bounding box annotations, preparing inputs for GRPO rollouts.

modules.name: Adaptive Multimodal Data Packer
modules.description: Implements the adaptive multimodal data-packing strategy to handle variable sequence lengths caused by dynamic image tokens and LVR tokens. Groups shorter instances together and limits the number of longer instances to achieve balanced effective batch sizes.

modules.name: LVR Model Architecture Extender
modules.description: Extends the standard Qwen2.5-VL architecture to support LVR by introducing special tokens (<|lvr_start|> and <|lvr_end|>) and modifying the embedding layer. Manages the separation and fusion of text embeddings, image embeddings, and LVR embeddings.

modules.name: Latent Visual Reasoning Forward Engine
modules.description: Implements the core forward pass logic for LVR. When in LVR mode, bypasses the language modeling head and passes the last hidden states directly as input embeddings to subsequent positions, reconstructing visual semantics in an autoregressive manner.

modules.name: SFT Joint Loss Calculator
modules.description: Computes the joint objective for Supervised Fine-Tuning, combining the Next-Token Prediction (NTP) cross-entropy loss for text generation and the Visual Reconstruction Loss (MSE) between the LVR hidden states and the target visual embeddings.

modules.name: GRPOlatent Objective Calculator
modules.description: Implements the adapted GRPO algorithm for latent reasoning. Computes the policy-gradient loss using teacher-forcing log-probability passes where recorded latent hidden states from rollouts are patched into the model to ensure consistent conditional probabilities for importance ratio calculation.

modules.name: RL Reward Function Evaluator
modules.description: Calculates the group-normalized rewards for reinforcement learning based on the generated text output. Includes a format reward for the presence of LVR special tokens and an accuracy reward for the correctness of the final answer.

modules.name: SFT Training Orchestrator
modules.description: Manages the Supervised Fine-Tuning loop. Handles gradient accumulation, mixed-precision training, and optimizer steps while freezing the visual encoder and multimodal projector, updating only the LLM backbone parameters.

modules.name: RL Training Orchestrator
modules.description: Controls the reinforcement learning loop using GRPOlatent. Manages the rollout generation for multiple responses per input, records LVR hidden states, and executes the policy update based on the computed advantages and KL penalties.

modules.name: LVR Decoding Strategy Handler
modules.description: Implements the three proposed decoding strategies for exiting the LVR mode: Fixed Token (constant budget), Latent End Token (trainable tensor distance thresholding), and Mode Switching Loss (supervising the LM head distribution towards the end token).

modules.name: Hybrid Inference Engine
modules.description: Executes auto-regressive inference that dynamically switches between standard text generation (sampling from the LM head) and latent visual reasoning (propagating hidden states) based on the model's emission of LVR trigger tokens and the chosen decoding stopping criterion.

modules.name: Perception-Centric Benchmark Evaluator
modules.description: Runs evaluation scripts on visual detail understanding and perception-intensive benchmarks (V*Bench, MMVP, BLINK subsets including Counting, JigSaw, Relative Reflectance, Spatial Relation) and computes the standardized accuracy metrics.

modules.name: Ablation Study Manager
modules.description: Configures and executes controlled ablation experiments, including architectural variants (MLP Head, GLU Head vs. standard LVR), decoding strategy comparisons, and variable LVR step length analysis to validate design choices.

modules.name: Visual Reasoning Analyzer
modules.description: Provides tools for visualizing the model's reasoning process, such as mapping the reconstructed latent visual tokens back to image patches to verify ROI focus, and analyzing the stability of the latent end token distances.

modules.name: Experiment Tracker and Logger
modules.description: Handles configuration management for SFT and RL stages, logs training metrics (loss, rewards, KL divergence), and integrates with experiment tracking frameworks to monitor the self-evolution of the latent visual reasoning process.
